All runs of the paper share one initial-condition realization (chosen for a typical halo mass function) and the Planck 2015 cosmology, so differences between them are model differences only. A single small box: cosmic variance is not included and the high-redshift end is limited by resolution. The line carries one vertex per output time (1e3 to 2.5e4 in the figure); it is resampled on bins of 0.05 in z by the mean of log10 SFRD. The density frame is not stated in the caption; the overlaid observational compilations (Behroozi+13, Oesch+15) are comoving densities and coincide with the curves, so comoving is inferred. Observational points are not extracted.
